"""Run the predeclared paired build comparison without changing models or scoring."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('Scripts').resolve()))
from model_files import inventory
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/optimized-eval-plan-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
output=Path('Training/experiments/optimized-eval-2026-09-17.json')
assert not output.exists()
record=dict(status='Incomplete paired evaluation; no performance or promotion claim.',plan=plan,
            driverSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),runs={})
def verify():
    for name,digest in {**plan['sourceSHA256'],**plan['retainedFilesSHA256'],**plan['fixtures']}.items():assert sha(name)==digest,name
    for name,path in plan['models'].items():assert inventory(Path(path))==plan['modelFiles'][name],name
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
verify();retain()
for model,build in plan['order']:
    verify()
    key=model+'-'+build
    directory=Path('.build/optimized-eval-'+key)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',plan['runners'][build],
                        '--model',plan['models'][model],'--output-directory',str(directory)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    verify()
    record['runs'][key]={**{name:json.loads((directory/(name+'.json')).read_text()) for name in ['report','evidence','failures']},
                        'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
                        'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
    retain()
    print(key,record['runs'][key]['report']['editPlanExact'],record['runs'][key]['report']['measurements']['latencyMilliseconds'],flush=True)
comparison={}
fields=['rawModelOutput','editPlan','output','outcome','fallbackReason','validationError','inputTokens','maximumInputTokens']
for model in plan['models']:
    debug,release=[record['runs'][model+'-'+build] for build in ['debug','release']]
    left={r['id']:r for r in debug['predictions']};right={r['id']:r for r in release['predictions']}
    assert set(left)==set(right) and len(left)==23
    changes={i:[f for f in fields if left[i].get(f)!=right[i].get(f)] for i in left}
    comparison[model]=dict(changedCases={i:fs for i,fs in changes.items() if fs},
        debugMeasurements=debug['report']['measurements'],releaseMeasurements=release['report']['measurements'])
record['comparison']=comparison
record['status']='Paired M5 Cleanup-only comparison complete; no model promotion or release performance claim.'
retain()
print(json.dumps(comparison),flush=True)
